Subtract 316 days from 1615-04-14.  
1615 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
316 days before April 14:  
Back 14 days → 1615-03-31.  
Back 302 more days: 302 days before March 31 → 302 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+29? Let’s count backward:  
March has 31 days, so 302 days earlier:  
March 31 → Feb 28 (31 days back) → Jan 31 (28 days back) → Dec 31 (31 days back) → Nov 30 (31 days back) → Oct 31 (30 days back) → Sep 30 (31 days back) → Aug 31 (30 days back) → Jul 31 (31 days back) → Jun 30 (31 days back) → May 31 (30 days back) → Apr 30 (31 days back) → Mar 31 (30 days back) → Feb 28 (31 days back) → Jan 28 (28 days back). Wait, recount systematically:  

Better: 316 days before April 14, 1615:  
Subtract 14 days → April 0 = March 31.  
Remaining 302 days:  
March 31 back 31 days → Feb 28 (1615).  
Feb 28 back 28 days → Jan 31 (1615).  
Jan 31 back 31 days → Dec 31 (1614).  
Dec 31 back 31 days → Nov 30 (1614).  
Nov 30 back 30 days → Oct 31 (1614).  
Oct 31 back 31 days → Sep 30 (1614).  
Sep 30 back 30 days → Aug 31 (1614).  
Aug 31 back 31 days → Jul 31 (1614).  
Jul 31 back 31 days → Jun 30 (1614).  
Jun 30 back 30 days → May 31 (1614).  
May 31 back 31 days → Apr 30 (1614).  
Apr 30 back 30 days → Mar 31 (1614).
